sentences.text: Shri Vikas Chouksey - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Arvind Singh - Government Advocate for the respond
Heard on the question of admission.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Heard on I.A. No.18445/2025, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Lalit @ Shatrughan Vishwakarma.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 17.10.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge,
POCSO Act, 2012, District-Betul in S.C. No.35/2023, whereby the appellant Lalit @ Shatrughan Vishwakarma stands convicted and sentenced as under :-

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that there are general and omnibus allegations against appellant Lalit @ Shatrughan Vishwakarma.

entities.text: Lalit @ Shatrughan Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: DNA report Ex.P/43 is positive only of co-accused Shivam @ Shubham Vishwakarma.
There are good chances of success in the appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Lalit and to release him on bail.
Shri Arvind Singh, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Lalit and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties each in the like 3 CRA-12385-2024 amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on 26.02.2026 and such other dates as may be fixed by the trial court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.18445/2025 is allowed & disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
Certified copy as per rules.
 (VIVEK AGARWAL) (RATNESH CHANDRA SIN  JUDGE JUDGE  RC Lalit @ Shatrughan Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152989125/
